verdict.rationale: Tilled's docs have a dedicated webhooks section and a WebhooksAPI that delivers real-time notifications to your application about platform events, which covers the core of subscribing to events. The evidence is only short overview snippets, so the details of how a subscription works are not shown. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and subscription/filtering mechanics, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
